# List

- **ListItem** (requires_parent): requires_parent: "must be composed inside UnorderedList; measured through UnorderedList's samples."
- **ListItem** (no_reference): no_reference: "no standalone upstream mount; measured through UnorderedList's samples."

## ListItem

One row of a text list with its marker; it must be composed inside UnorderedList or OrderedList and is measured through the lists' samples (no standalone upstream mount).

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | yes | The row's text. |
| `kind` | `string` | no | Composition prop: `unordered`, `ordered` or `native` - the marker glyph and offset. |
| `index` | `number` | no | Composition prop: the 1-based ordinal for the `n.`/`a.` markers. |
| `nested` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: the item sits in a nested list (square/lower-latin marker, nested padding). |
| `expressive` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: the expressive list type. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `indent` | `control.text_list_indent` |
| `nestedIndent` | `control.text_list_nested_indent` |
| `nestedItemPadding` | `control.text_list_nested_item_padding` |
| `nestedMarkerOffset` | `control.text_list_nested_marker_offset` |
| `ordinalOffset` | `control.text_list_ordinal_offset` |
| `markerOffset` | `control.text_list_marker_offset` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"label":"List item","kind":"unordered"}` |

## OrderedList

A numbered list with `n.` markers (lower-latin `a.` nested; `native` uses the browser's decimal marker).

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array` | yes | The rows: `string` labels or `{ label, items }` for a nested list. |
| `isExpressive` | `boolean` | no | Draws the expressive list type. |
| `native` | `boolean` | no | Draws the native decimal marker (`n.` at the ordinal offset - upstream's `::marker` has no RNW equivalent). |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | The list landmark's name. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `indent` | `control.text_list_indent` |
| `nestedIndent` | `control.text_list_nested_indent` |
| `nestedItemPadding` | `control.text_list_nested_item_padding` |
| `nestedMarkerOffset` | `control.text_list_nested_marker_offset` |
| `ordinalOffset` | `control.text_list_ordinal_offset` |
| `markerOffset` | `control.text_list_marker_offset` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| ordered | `{"items":["List item 1","List item 2","List item 3"]}` |
| orderedExpressive | `{"items":["List item 1","List item 2","List item 3"],"isExpressive":true}` |
| orderedNested | `{"items":[{"label":"List item 1"},{"label":"List item 2","items":["Nested item 1","Nested item 2"]},{"label":"List item 3"}]}` |
| orderedNative | `{"items":["List item 1","List item 2","List item 3"],"native":true}` |
| orderedNativeNested | `{"items":[{"label":"List item 1"},{"label":"List item 2","items":["Nested item 1","Nested item 2"]},{"label":"List item 3"}],"native":true}` |
